messages:
sylvia: forwarding BlueWave report — they hit a parser error in prod after today's rollout (canary->full at 2026-03-10 03:12 UTC). They say the `items` array is now an object keyed by indices, client JSON parser chokes. request_id=rq_abc123

aj: thanks — can you paste the exact payload they received and the request body they sent? sample would help.

sylvia: customer attached before/after. before (expected):
```json
{
  "order_id": 9876,
  "items": [
    {"id": 123, "qty": 1},
    {"id": 124, "qty": 2}
  ]
}
```
after (what their parser got):
```json
{
  "order_id": 9876,
  "items": {
    "0": {"id": 123, "qty": 1},
    "1": {"id": 124, "qty": 2}
  }
}
```

sylvia: their client code expects an array and uses equality checks on length; so this breaks downstream. Happening on route `/v1/generate/json-output` with model `rwd-v2.3-quant` (rolled at 03:12). They only started seeing it after full rollout.

leo: interesting — sample looks like array->object conversion (index keys as strings). Not typical of LLM output mistakes (we usually see stringification). Could be our post-processing serializer or a protobuf -> json conversion step. Did they send `prefer_object=true` or some client param?

sylvia: they say no special flags. They pasted the curl for repro:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/json-output \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-live-xxxx' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"prompt":"build order","format":"items_array"}'
```
request id header from our side: `x-rwd-request-id: rq_abc123`

aj: ok grabbing logs. opsbot, can you pull the serving trace for rq_abc123 (model rwd-v2.3-quant, route json-output) and paste kernel/serializer hints?

opsbot: Trace found — routing: CANARY->FULL; runtime-hook `compact_json_transform` applied at postprocess step. serializer version v1.2.4.

leo: that `compact_json_transform` sounds suspicious. It tries to compact arrays into objects to save bytes in some legacy mobile flows (we added it for an edge case months ago). It should be gated by a flag but maybe the gate flipped for `json-output` during rollout.\n
aj: priority: repro locally. leo — can you run a quick unit that hits postprocess v1.2.4 with the same tokens and verify behavior? I can also rollback the transform flag on the canary traffic if repro confirms.

sylvia: customer is blocked (parser exceptions, 500s). they asked for ETA and whether we can revert.

leo: reproed it locally — `compact_json_transform` converts arrays of small objects to index-keyed objects when `preserve_arrays=false` (default flipped). Patch: revert default to `preserve_arrays=true` and create a hotfix. Creating PR now.

aj: thanks. I'll open INC-4321, mark P1, and notify CS. sylvia — tell BlueWave we can either roll a hotfix within ~2 hours or provide a temporary POST-processing workaround (we can return `x-rwd-workaround: preserve-arrays` header they can set).

sylvia: passing to customer: they prefer hotfix. I'll update the ticket and ask for any more sample failures.

opsbot: INC-4321 created by aj — hotfix branch rwd/fix/preserve-arrays, deploy to canary queue started.

aj: quick note for postmortem — need a unit test that asserts `items` arrays remain arrays for `json-output` route; also audit toggles that could flip by mistake during rollout.

leo: agreed. Also adding telemetry check: count of responses that have `items` as object vs array over time; will alert if >0.1% in prod.

sylvia: thanks team. will close thread when customer confirms fix in ~2h. :thumbsup:
